description: Every interaction is built from these behaviour tokens. A token fixes which channels move, how long (a --cc-* duration), how (a --cc-ease-* or named easing), along what path, with which sound, and where it ends. Components and step recipes are compositions of tokens; they never set their own timing.

sfx.rule: Noise or one glide, same pitch on repeats, host mute (__MAX_MUTED__) honoured on every call. Two-note rising = correct only; two-note falling = wrong only.

palette.whoosh: band-pass noise 500→1800 Hz over the travel

roles.given: data-role=emphasis (quantities in the problem text and figure labels)
roles.known: data-role=action (found values A, B, C… and every recall of them)

behaviours.means: Something new is written: it rises into place.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A line is written left to right, one symbol after another.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A result, frame or new part comes to full strength where it already stands.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: An object has done its job and goes: brackets, cancelled factors, cleared working.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: A new model enters faint, then comes to full strength.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: The rest of a whole recedes while one part is studied; text is muted, never faded.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: An object changes place in a straight line.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A term or value travels to a new place over the others: crossing the =, flying from the problem text, a ledger, or another line.
behaviours.path: quadratic arc, apex --cc-arc-lift above the higher end
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: Two or more tokens become one: they travel to a shared centre and fade out after --cc-fade-at of the travel.
behaviours.endState: removed; the result is in their place
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: The line is carried down as a live copy to be worked on; the line it came from stays as history.
behaviours.endState: copy one pitch below; the source line muted
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: Neighbours slide apart or close up so nothing overlaps when a token splits, merges, arrives or leaves.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once
behaviours.notes: glide applied to every neighbour at once

behaviours.means: A decimal point or token steps one place at a time.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A dragged object seats on a target.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: An object is picked up by the learner: rises, tilts from the grab point, shadow deepens.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A dropped or arriving object comes to rest with one small overshoot.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A refused object shakes (judged wrong), pauses, and travels back where it started; its mark clears on the way.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: The working is full: everything glides up one pitch; lines leaving the top leave.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: Objects with weight fall, bounce, swing or slide by simulation, not easing.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: One token opens into its parts from its own centre (18 → 6 × 3, % → ÷ 100).
behaviours.endState: parts in the line; the token removed
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A symbol is rewritten in place: of → ×, + → − while crossing.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: A sign turns half a turn into its opposite (> → <).
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: Things that are the same thing take the same categorical hue (data-hue: teal, pink, gold, grape, azure).
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once
behaviours.notes: At most four hues on a board, reserved correct/wrong arcs excluded.

behaviours.means: A value takes its ledger role everywhere it appears (a known A, B… is Action).
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: A line becomes history: still readable, in --cc-muted.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: A tinted frame surrounds the part being worked on and travels with it.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: The result line is framed in the Action role.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: Numbered badges tick over the items being counted, one --cc-beat apart.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A diagonal stroke draws through each partner that cancels, then they leave.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: Dotted arcs from a multiplier to every term it will touch.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A line, arc, rule or construction draws from its start.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A relation slot takes its sign and teeters once.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: Judgement on the object: correct swells, wrong wiggles, with a check or cross beside it.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: The one next thing to act on pulses twice.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: The learner’s finger on what to act on, looping until the first tap.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: A given quantity leaves the problem text or figure label and becomes a token in the working.
behaviours.endState: token in the line; the source stays marked
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A found value travels from the working into its slot in the knowns rail (or a table cell) and the slot comes to strength.
behaviours.endState: slot shows the value in the Action role
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A known travels from the rail into a later line of working.
behaviours.endState: token in the line, Action role kept
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

behaviours.means: A finished sub-problem leaves; the statement, figure and knowns stay.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once

behaviours.means: The part of the figure being used takes a concept fill.
behaviours.reducedMotion: end state at once ; end sound once

recipes.means: Write a line; tokens with a source fly from it.
Carry the line down to work on it. In a named chain (#A = …) the name leaves and the = hangs under the first =.
Show what acts next.
Release the frame.
Same thing, same hue.
Back to ink.
Bind a value to its ledger role.
Reject a candidate; it stays readable.
One token opens into parts.
Tokens become their result.
Rewrite a symbol.
Cross the = or regroup; the operation inverts mid-flight.
Turn a sign into its opposite.
Partners cancel.
Open a gap and put something in it.
Something that has done its job goes.
Show what a multiplier will reach.
Copies of the multiplier land on each term.
Two terms make a product on the new line.
Substitute a value for a letter.
Count places or repeated factors.
Move the decimal point.
Fractions multiply onto one bar.
Equal denominators become one bar.
A denominator of 1 drops.
Rule under stacked equations.
Add or subtract lines column by column; opposites vanish.
Small working note beside a side list (never names a step).
Frame the result; a named chain gets its name back (A = 10).
Show the problem with given quantities marked.
Show the figure with labelled given quantities.
Show the knowns rail with empty slots.
A found value goes to its slot.
Finish a sub-problem.
Shade the part of the figure in use.
Pause.
Change the spacing before a token; applied at the next layout.
Remove reach arcs.
